description: QC-005 HHL. n<=2 integer A and rational b,x. Checks A x = b exactly. Does not invert. Floats refused.

b.description: right-hand side b as comma-separated rationals, one per row, e.g. 2,4

matrix.description: integer matrix A, 1x1 or 2x2: rows separated by '|', entries by ',', e.g. 2,0|0,2

x.description: the presented solution x as comma-separated rationals, e.g. 1,2; the court checks A x = b exactly and never inverts

name: verify_hhl
